en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5) 11.2.
Kusala-ttika, Vipāka-ttika
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant, a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant, a state that is unwholesome and not resultant arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant, a state that is indeterminate and not resultant arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor resultant and also neither-indeterminate-nor-resultant by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor resultant and also not-unwholesome-nor-resultant by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant, a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant arises by way of root condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor resultant, a state that is neither indeterminate nor resultant arises by way of root condition … six.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant and a state that is neither indeterminate nor resultant, a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant arises by way of root condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor resultant and neither indeterminate nor resultant, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant by way of root condition … five.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor resultant and neither unwholesome nor resultant, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor resultant by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.

In the case of root [condition] there are twenty-nine; in the case of object [condition] there are twenty-four … pe … in the case of resultant [condition] there are nine … pe … in the case of non-disappearance [condition] there are twenty-nine. (Full detail for all.)
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to ripening, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to ripening by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to ripening, there arises a state that is unwholesome and not subject to ripening by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to ripening, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor subject to ripening...
And non-unwholesome states that are not of a nature to ripen as kamma-result arise by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to ripen as kamma-result, a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to ripen as kamma-result arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to ripen as kamma-result, a wholesome state that is not of a nature to ripen as kamma-result [arises]...

[They] arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-resultant-of-the-nature-of-result, there arise states that are neither-wholesome-nor-resultant-of-the-nature-of-result and states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-resultant-of-the-nature-of-result by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both neither-unwholesome-nor-resultant-of-the-nature-of-result and neither-unwholesome-nor-resultant-of-the-nature-of-result...
A non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to result in kamma-result arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to result in kamma-result and a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to result in kamma-result, a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to result in kamma-result arises by way of root-condition. [Dependent on] a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to result in kamma-result and a non-unwholesome state that is not of a nature to result in kamma-result...

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor of a nature to result in kamma-result, states that are neither wholesome nor of a nature to result in kamma-result arise by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
Nine for root; ... pe ... nine for non-disappearance. (Nine in all cases.)

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor productive of result nor subject to result, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor productive of result nor subject to result by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root [condition], twenty-four; ... pe ...
in the case of repetition [condition], seventeen; ... pe ... in the case of resultant [condition], nine; ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance [condition], twenty-four.
